steps.text: If the player finds leather inside the crate:
This appears to have been a shipment of treated animal hides. You find a piece in good condition.
a piece of leather
If the player finds a steel scimitar inside the crate:
This appears to have been a shipment of weapons. You find just one left in the crate.
a steel scimitar
If the player finds a silver bar inside the crate:
This appears to have been a shipment of metals. You find a piece that looks unweathered.
a silver bar
If the player finds a 4-dose strength potion inside the crate:
This appears to have been a shipment of potions. You take the one that is still corked.
a strength potion (4)
If the player finds steel arrows inside the crate:
This appears to have been a shipment of ammunition.You take what you find inside.
40 steel arrows
If the player finds sawmill coupon (wood plank) inside the crate:
This appears to have been a shipment of construction supplies. You take the ones not damaged by water.
20 sawmill coupon (wood plank)
If the player finds sweetcorn seeds inside the crate:
This appears to have been a shipment of farming goods. You take what's left of the seeds inside.
6 sweetcorn seeds
If the player finds mind runes inside the crate:
This appears to have been a shipment of runes. You take what's left of them.
80 mind runes
